description: Mosques and prayer rooms (musholla, surau) near a city or coordinates, nearest first, with listed facilities (Jumu'ah, women's prayer area, wudu) and each one's HalalTrip page.

facilities.description: Only places listing all of these: jumuah (Friday prayers), women (women's prayer area), wudu (ablution facilities).

kind.description: Mosques only, prayer rooms only, or both. Default both.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, instead of place.

limit.description: How many places, 1 to 10, nearest first. Default 5.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, instead of place.

place.description: City name, optionally with country ("Kuala Lumpur", "London, United Kingdom"), or a neighbourhood or landmark in HalalTrip's listings ("Bugis, Singapore"). For other areas, give coordinates.

radius_km.description: How far to look, in km (1 to 25). Default 5.

name: find_places_to_pray
title: Mosques and prayer rooms nearby
